question:
The surface area of a sphere is 221.76 cm². Its volume (in cm³) is (correct to one decimal place):

(Take π = {(22)/(7)})
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area = 4πr² = 221.76 cm²

r² = (221.76 × 7) ÷ (4 × 22) = 17.64 ⇒ r = 4.2 cm

Relation: Volume = (Surface Area × r) ÷ 3

Volume = (221.76 × 4.2) ÷ 3 = 310.464 ≈ 310.5 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 310.5 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface Area of sphere = 221.76 cm²

π = 22/7

**Formula:**

Surface Area (S) = 4πr²

Volume (V) = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62be1d0a6dd436e050219edc574b5dbe7950c1713fb513131ffe4e799fc4a082.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r² = 221.76

⇒ r² = (221.76 × 7) ÷ (4 × 22)

⇒ r² = 1552.32 ÷ 88 = 17.64

⇒ r = √17.64 = 4.2 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × (4.2)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 74.088

⇒ Volume = 310.464 cm³

⇒ Volume ≈ 310.5 cm³ (to one decimal place)

**∴ The correct answer is 310.5 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume represents the capacity of the sphere, calculated as V = (4/3)πr³.

Total Surface Area of a Sphere

A sphere has only one continuous surface, so its Curved Surface Area (CSA) and Total Surface Area (TSA) are both 4πr².

Hemisphere Formulas

For a hemisphere of radius r: CSA = 2πr², TSA = 3πr², and Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio Property

If the ratio of the radii of two spheres is a:b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a²:b² and the ratio of their volumes is a³:b³.</p
